APPROVAL TO OPEN SALE OF RESIDENTIAL & COMMERCIAL PLOTS IN ICON VALLEY PHASE 2-LAND EXTENSION

Back Ground:
Icon Valley Phase 2 is a large-scale, mixed-use real estate development located on Main Raiwind Road, Lahore,
being developed by Icon Developers. The project is currently spread over an area of approximately 364 Kanal
and has been approved by the Lahore Development Authority (LDA), establishing regulatory compliance and
providing investment security to prospective buyers.
Subsequent to the initial approval, the developer has acquired an additional 205 Kanal of land intended to be
incorporated into the existing project footprint. Accordingly, the developer has prepared a revised master plan,
which has been duly submitted to the LDA for approval.
Supporting documentation evidencing the submission and proposed expansion including the LDA submission
slip, revised layout/map, khasra plan, and land ownership records is attached for reference.

A significant portion of the additional acquired land, approximately 57.5%, is owned by Mr. Zia Mohi Ud Din,
who has already executed the Sale and Marketing Agreement with our company. The provided Aks Shajras
clearly demonstrate that the entire newly acquired land forming Block D falls within his ownership.
Furthermore, signatures of all other respective landowners have also been obtained on the Zameen Media Sale
and Marketing Agreement, ensuring documented consent and alignment from all stakeholders.
Progress on Previous Approvals:
Previously, approval was sought from the Competent Authority to launch the following two projects in the
absence of final LDA approval. The progress status of the same is summarized below:
1. Icon Valley Phase 1
•

The developer has shared signed LDA Minutes of the Meeting of the Scrutiny Committee, confirming
that Technical Approval has been granted for Icon Valley Phase 1.

2. ICON Walk – 67 Kanal ADP Commercial
•

The developer has obtained and paid the Master Plan Submission Challan amounting to PKR 22.614
million, which indicates that the Master Plan has been approved. However, 6 out of 8
commercialization challans have also been paid. The developer has committed to sharing the final

approval documentation along with all paid commercialization challans with Zameen Media in due
course.
Progress on Approval of Case at Hand (Land Extension):
The case has been duly submitted with the Lahore Development Authority (LDA) and is currently progressing
through the approval process in accordance with standard regulatory practice. ICON Developers has procured
the complete underlying land, and the Master Plan submission challan / confirmation is expected to be shared
with us within the next 3 to 3.5 months.

Phase 2 has already been approved by the regulator, and

for this phase is expected within 3-3.5 months.

will be closely monitored to mitigate any potential
delays.

Rationale of Approval:
Based on the fact that significant progress has been achieved against the previous approvals granted by
Management for ICON Developers’ projects in the absence of final LDA approvals. The developer has actively
coordinated with LDA, and the respective cases are progressing towards approval as per standard regulatory
practice. Additionally, the developer has now procured and consolidated the underlying land, and the
ownership position has been strengthened, with the land being cleared and owned under the name of Mr. Zia
Mohi Ud Din (MD, ICON Developers). This materially improves the documentation comfort and reduces
execution risk. Furthermore, ICON Developers is a longstanding and high-revenue generating client of Zameen
Media. Zameen holds exclusive sales rights for 58 Commercial Plots/Plazas and 166 Residential Plots,
representing an approximate project value of PKR 3.3 billion, with an expected revenue of PKR 599 million. In
view of this strategic relationship and the commercial significance of the partnership, it is suggested to consider
the subject approval favorably.
